title: GENERIO.ai 3D Model Gnerator Big Update (Qwen Image Edit 2509 for free)
author: Rizzlord
selftext:
Hey, we from [GENERIO.ai](https://generio.ai/) rolled out a big update with better textures, Qwen image edit 2509 for better generation and style adaptation and much more. We also have a [Community Discord](https://discord.gg/rxMeCDyw) and a Market which got new Assets for you to download. 

Future Plans are: 

1. Ultra Quality models and textures.

2. Market will have Buy and sellable models from and for the Community, which you can sell, and we take a small fee for the use of the market system. Also you can sell and buy Whole Asset packs in styles.

3. Unity, Unreal and Godot Plugins for ease of use.

4. Direct model geometry change with marking a part of the model and change the geometry.

5. Model Seperation, for cars etc.

comments.author: LionAlhazred
comments.body: Is it possible to create retro 3D models and retro textures (like on the N64)?

replies.author: Rizzlord
replies.body: Yeah, but you would have to edit them in tools like gimp and blender, because they have special settings you have to have. But you can try it out. The free account is 3 days unlimited model creation.

comments.author: beyawnko
comments.body: How does this compare to Hunyuan 3d 3? Been using Rodin mainly, but always looking out for new models

replies.author: Rizzlord
replies.body: We still try to improve details of the models themselves, we focus more on creativity and easier to use. With the future ultra model, we will have way better details, but we are still working hard on that.

replies.body: Retopo in it's way, but they are unwrapped
